Pushed one small commit on top. If `_extract_usage` raised on a malformed cache count (a `cached_tokens` that decodes to inf is enough), the surrounding handler dropped the whole receipt, which main still recorded. It now falls back to no cache counts and keeps the prompt/completion/total entry, with a test.
